comment: UNENFORCED legacy scaffold. The LIVE fallback authority is now family-aware routing in scripts/hooks/lib/providers.js (suggestFallbackProvider + PROVIDER_FAMILY) — a quota/outage fallback lands in a DIFFERENT model family, never same-family. This file's per-role policies below carry legacy role keys (reviewer/compliance/qa) and legacy model ids; they are documentation only and no consumer routes off them. Individual `gemini` CLI targets point to antigravity (agy). Do not treat the ids below as authoritative.

security-reviewer.rationale: security-reviewer (was redteam) runs adversarial-corpus reasoning; the Gemini lab is the primary, served through the Antigravity `agy` CLI (the individual-tier gemini CLI is SUNSET). CROSS-FAMILY fallback: a Google-lab outage retries on the GPT lab (openai:gpt-5.6-sol), never another google endpoint; a total outage falls through runProvider's provider-level fallback. A SECOND security pass ALWAYS runs on openai:gpt-5.6-sol so security covers two model families. deep_fallback is the Claude hunter lane (claude-opus-4-8) as a last-resort known-good.

reviewer.rationale: GPT-5.6 Sol xhigh is the diversity lens against Claude builders. Falling back to claude-sonnet-4-6 keeps gauntlets moving when codex is unreachable.

qa.rationale: qa runs 13 personas — cost-balanced primary. Haiku fallback keeps per-persona cost predictable on outages.

notes: auth_source_mismatch deliberately does NOT auto-fall-back. The user has set both API key AND OAuth — failing closed surfaces the configuration ambiguity rather than silently using the wrong account.
